# Cncf Zot Reviewer

Review zot using its official documentation and repository in the Provisioning / Container Registry category. Zot is an OCI-native container registry for distributing container images and OCI artifacts.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
